messages:
anshul: ran the nightly link audit on /runtime and spotted 3 broken fragment links that affect a few ops runbooks: #batch-size, #kv-cache-impl, #scale-targets

link-bot: automated-scan: 3 broken anchor(s) in /runtime (batch-size, kv-cache-impl, scale-targets). suggested fix: add explicit anchors or normalize header slugs.

marie: can someone paste the header lines? i don't want to accidentally change wording in the guide.

anshul: quick grep: 
```
docs/runtime.md:120:# Batching strategies for latency
docs/runtime.md:201:# KV cache (notes)
docs/runtime.md:289:# Scaling targets and policies
```
headers exist but the mdx slugger created different ids. adding explicit anchors above each header is safest.

sahil: i'll add HTML anchors for all three and open a tiny PR titled "fix(rtd): explicit anchors for legacy runbook links". tag @marie for review.

marie: perfect — prefer anchors so header copy remains stable. i'll try to review within 2 hours.

anshul: added to docs board under "quick fixes". will re-run the scan after merge and report back.

link-bot: scan scheduled after PR merge. will post verification here.

sahil: PR up as draft, includes a short note about why we didn't rename headers. tagging ops runbook owners.

marie: LGTM, approving now. merging after CI passes.

anshul: thanks! post-merge scan shows no remaining broken anchors. closing the ticket. :white_check_mark:
